blocks.zh: Section 2C: Part I Glossary — Key Terms & Definitions｜第一部分術語與定義
blocks.en: Section 2C: Part I Glossary — Key Terms & Definitions

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 精確掌握 ICH Q8(R2) Part I 的六個核心術語官方定義
blocks.en: Master the official definitions of the six core terms in ICH Q8(R2) Part I

blocks.zh: 理解各術語在製藥開發實務中的應用邊界，避免常見混淆
blocks.en: Understand the practical boundaries of each term in pharmaceutical development, and avoid common confusion

blocks.zh: 建立術語間的關聯性思維（Design Space → CPV → Lifecycle → Quality 的概念脈絡）
blocks.en: Build a connected view of the terms (Design Space → CPV → Lifecycle → Quality)

blocks.zh: 能夠在 CTD 送審文件中正確引用並運用這些術語
blocks.en: Cite and apply these terms correctly in CTD submission documents

blocks.zh: 核心術語（一）：Continuous Process Verification & Design Space｜持續製程查驗與設計空間
blocks.en: Core Terms (1): Continuous Process Verification & Design Space

blocks.zh: 中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: Continuous Process Verification（CPV）持續製程查驗
blocks.en: Continuous Process Verification (CPV)

blocks.zh: 官方定義：製程驗證的替代方法——持續監控並評估製造製程的績效。
blocks.en: Official definition: An alternative approach to process validation in which manufacturing process performance is continuously monitored and evaluated.

blocks.zh: CPV 是 FDA 2011 年《製程驗證指南》所推廣的「第三階段驗證」概念，相對於傳統的「三批次驗證一次性方法」，CPV 代表製程驗證的範式轉移：
blocks.en: CPV reflects the "Stage 3" concept promoted by the FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance. Compared with the traditional one-time "three-batch validation" approach, CPV represents a paradigm shift in process validation:

blocks.zh: 傳統 PV：三批驗證通過 → 宣告製程已驗證 → 固定製程
blocks.en: Traditional PV: three batches pass validation → process declared validated → process fixed

blocks.zh: CPV：持續收集數據 → 統計過程控制（SPC）→ 持續確認製程受控狀態
blocks.en: CPV: continuous data collection → statistical process control (SPC) → ongoing confirmation that the process remains in a state of control

blocks.zh: CPV 需要完善的製程監控體系，包括 inline/atline/online 量測技術，通常與 PAT 工具配合使用。
blocks.en: CPV requires a sound process monitoring system, including inline/atline/online measurement techniques, and is usually used together with PAT tools.

blocks.zh: Design Space（設計空間）——最重要的 Q8 術語
blocks.en: Design Space — the most important Q8 term

blocks.zh: 官方定義要素拆解：
blocks.en: Breaking down the official definition:

blocks.zh: 多維度組合（multidimensional）：不是單一變數的範圍，而是多個輸入變數的交互作用空間
blocks.en: Multidimensional combination: not the range of a single variable, but the space of interactions among multiple input variables

blocks.zh: 輸入變數：包含物料屬性（material attributes）和製程參數（process parameters）
blocks.en: Input variables: include both material attributes and process parameters

blocks.zh: 已驗證提供品質保證（demonstrated to provide assurance of quality）：必須有科學數據支持
blocks.en: Demonstrated to provide assurance of quality: must be supported by scientific data

blocks.zh: 最關鍵的監管含義：在 Design Space 內操作不算「變更」，不需要提交 post-approval change（補充申請）。這是 QbD 帶來的最大監管彈性。
blocks.en: The most important regulatory implication: operating within the Design Space is not considered a "change" and does not require a post-approval change submission (supplement). This is the greatest regulatory flexibility that QbD offers.

blocks.zh: 詳細關係見 Part II Annex 2.4.5。
blocks.en: For the detailed relationship, see Part II Annex 2.4.5.

blocks.zh: 核心術語（二）：Formal Experimental Design & Lifecycle｜正式試驗設計與生命週期
blocks.en: Core Terms (2): Formal Experimental Design & Lifecycle

blocks.zh: Formal Experimental Design（正式試驗設計，DoE）
blocks.en: Formal Experimental Design (DoE)

blocks.zh: 官方定義：用結構化、有組織的方法確定影響製程因素與製程輸出之間關係的方法，即「試驗設計（Design of Experiments）」。
blocks.en: Official definition: A structured, organized method for determining the relationship between factors affecting a process and the output of that process, also known as "Design of Experiments".

blocks.zh: Q8 多次提到 DoE 在以下場景的應用：
blocks.en: Q8 refers to the use of DoE in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 識別關鍵配方屬性（2.2.1）
blocks.en: Identifying critical formulation attributes (2.2.1)

blocks.zh: 識別 CPP 與 CQA 的關係（2.3）
blocks.en: Identifying the relationship between CPPs and CQAs (2.3)

blocks.zh: 建立 Design Space（Part II Annex 2.4）
blocks.en: Establishing the Design Space (Part II Annex 2.4)

blocks.zh: 常見 DoE 設計：Plackett-Burman（篩選）→ Central Composite Design（優化）→ Mixture Design（配方）。
blocks.en: Common DoE designs: Plackett-Burman (screening) → Central Composite Design (optimization) → Mixture Design (formulation).

blocks.zh: Lifecycle（生命週期）的定義與 ICH Q 三部曲
blocks.en: Definition of Lifecycle and the ICH Q trilogy

blocks.zh: 官方定義：從初始開發到上市再到退市的產品全生命週期。
blocks.en: Official definition: All phases in the life of a product from the initial development through marketing until the product's discontinuation.

blocks.zh: Q8「生命週期」概念是整個 ICH Q 三部曲的基礎哲學：
blocks.en: The Q8 "lifecycle" concept is the foundational philosophy of the whole ICH Q trilogy:

blocks.zh: 「生命週期管理」意味著 3.2.P.2（製劑開發）章節可以在整個產品生命週期中持續更新，以納入新知識。
blocks.en: "Lifecycle management" means that Section 3.2.P.2 (Pharmaceutical Development) can be updated throughout the product lifecycle to incorporate new knowledge.

blocks.zh: 核心術語（三）：PAT, Process Robustness & Quality｜製程分析技術、製程穩健性與品質
blocks.en: Core Terms (3): PAT, Process Robustness & Quality

blocks.zh: Process Analytical Technology（PAT）製程分析技術
blocks.en: Process Analytical Technology (PAT)

blocks.zh: 官方定義核心：透過對原物料和製程中物料的關鍵品質及性能屬性進行及時量測（即製程中），達到設計、分析和控制製造的系統。
blocks.en: Core of the official definition: A system for designing, analyzing, and controlling manufacturing through timely measurements (i.e., during processing) of critical quality and performance attributes of raw and in-process materials.

blocks.zh: PAT 的三個維度：
blocks.en: The three dimensions of PAT:

blocks.zh: 設計（Designing）：在開發階段建立量測方法，理解製程
blocks.en: Designing: establish measurement methods during development to understand the process

blocks.zh: 分析（Analyzing）：即時數據分析，理解製程狀態
blocks.en: Analyzing: real-time data analysis to understand the state of the process

blocks.zh: 控制（Controlling）：基於量測結果進行即時製程調整
blocks.en: Controlling: make real-time process adjustments based on measurement results

blocks.zh: 常見 PAT 工具：NIR（近紅外光譜）用於水分/含量監測、Raman 光譜、在線粒徑分析、pH/溫度感測器。PAT 是 CPV 的技術基礎。
blocks.en: Common PAT tools: NIR (near-infrared spectroscopy) for moisture/content monitoring, Raman spectroscopy, online particle size analysis, pH/temperature sensors. PAT is the technical foundation of CPV.

blocks.zh: 類比：PAT 如同飛機的自動駕駛儀
blocks.en: Analogy: PAT is like an aircraft autopilot

blocks.zh: 傳統製造 = 飛行員靠目視導航，偶爾查儀表（製程中很少量測，只靠終點測試）。PAT = 全自動駕駛儀，持續感測器數據 → 即時調整 → 確保精準飛行路徑。PAT 讓製程控制從「製後檢驗」轉變為「製中保證」，這是 Real-Time Release Testing（RTRT）的技術前提。
blocks.en: Traditional manufacturing = a pilot navigating by sight and checking the instruments now and then (few in-process measurements, relying only on end-point testing). PAT = a fully automatic autopilot: continuous sensor data → real-time adjustment → an accurate flight path. PAT shifts process control from "inspection after manufacture" to "assurance during manufacture", which is the technical prerequisite for Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT).

blocks.zh: Process Robustness（製程穩健性）
blocks.en: Process Robustness

blocks.zh: 官方定義：製程在材料變異及製程/設備變化下，不對品質產生負面影響的承受能力。
blocks.en: Official definition: The ability of a process to tolerate variability of materials and changes of the process and equipment without negative impact on quality.

blocks.zh: 穩健性是 Design Space 概念的實踐層次：
blocks.en: Robustness is the practical expression of the Design Space concept:

blocks.zh: Design Space 定義了「哪個範圍可以操作」
blocks.en: Design Space defines "the range within which operation is permitted"

blocks.zh: Process Robustness 描述「在這個範圍內，製程對波動的抵抗力」
blocks.en: Process Robustness describes "how well the process resists fluctuation within that range"

blocks.zh: 穩健性高 → 日常操作遠離 edge of failure → 製造風險低
blocks.en: High robustness → routine operation stays far from the edge of failure → low manufacturing risk

blocks.zh: 穩健性評估通常以 DOE 進行，結果支持 CPP 操作範圍的設定。
blocks.en: Robustness is usually evaluated with DoE, and the results support setting the CPP operating ranges.

blocks.zh: Quality（品質）的官方定義——注意其限制性
blocks.en: The official definition of Quality — note its limited scope

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 對「品質」的定義直接引用 ICH Q6A：藥品或原料藥對其預期用途的適合性，包括鑑別、效價和純度。
blocks.en: ICH Q8 takes its definition of "quality" directly from ICH Q6A: the suitability of either a drug substance or drug product for its intended use, including such attributes as identity, strength, and purity.

blocks.zh: 這個定義相對「窄」——主要聚焦在理化和微生物層面。注意與日常用語「品質」的區別：
blocks.en: This definition is relatively "narrow", focusing mainly on the physicochemical and microbiological aspects. Note how it differs from everyday use of the word "quality":

blocks.zh: 不直接包含「療效」或「安全性」（由 CQA 間接連結）
blocks.en: It does not directly include "efficacy" or "safety" (these are linked indirectly through CQAs)

blocks.zh: 「鑑別、效價、純度」是規格測試的三個核心維度
blocks.en: "Identity, strength, and purity" are the three core dimensions of specification testing

blocks.zh: Q8 後續引入 QTPP 和 CQA 來擴展品質內涵
blocks.en: Q8 later introduces the QTPP and CQAs to broaden the meaning of quality

blocks.zh: 術語整合應用測試
blocks.en: Integrated Terminology Application Test

blocks.zh: 說明為何「在 Design Space 內操作不視為變更」對 CDMO 客戶的實際生產意義。
blocks.en: Explain why "operating within the Design Space is not considered a change" matters in practice for a CDMO's clients' production.

blocks.zh: PAT 和 CPV 有何關聯？為何 Q8 術語表需要同時定義兩者？
blocks.en: How are PAT and CPV related? Why does the Q8 glossary need to define both?

blocks.zh: 一個具高度 Process Robustness 的製程，其 Design Space 與 Normal Operating Range 的關係如何？
blocks.en: For a process with high Process Robustness, what is the relationship between its Design Space and its Normal Operating Range?

blocks.zh: Q8 對「品質」的官方定義為何不直接提及「安全性」或「療效」？這種定義方式有何目的？
blocks.en: Why does the official Q8 definition of "quality" not directly mention "safety" or "efficacy"? What is the purpose of defining it this way?

blocks.zh: Part I 術語總覽對照表
blocks.en: Part I Glossary Overview Table

blocks.zh: 中文速查與記憶框架
blocks.en: Quick Reference and Memory Framework

blocks.zh: 術語關聯圖（記憶框架）
blocks.en: Term Relationship Map (Memory Framework)

blocks.zh: 以下是七個術語的邏輯關聯：
blocks.en: The logical relationships among the seven terms are as follows:

blocks.zh: Lifecycle（生命週期） ← 整體時間框架，Q8、Q9、Q10 共享
blocks.en: Lifecycle ← the overall time frame, shared by Q8, Q9 and Q10

blocks.zh: Formal Experimental Design（DoE） ← 建立知識的工具
blocks.en: Formal Experimental Design (DoE) ← the tool for building knowledge

blocks.zh: ↓ DoE 產生知識 → 定義 Design Space
blocks.en: ↓ DoE generates knowledge → defines the Design Space

blocks.zh: PAT ← 在 Design Space 內進行即時監控的技術
blocks.en: PAT ← the technology for real-time monitoring within the Design Space

blocks.zh: Process Robustness ← 描述 Design Space 的「寬度」和彈性
blocks.en: Process Robustness ← describes the "width" and flexibility of the Design Space

blocks.zh: CPV ← 利用 PAT 數據持續驗證製程狀態
blocks.en: CPV ← uses PAT data to continuously verify the state of the process

blocks.zh: Quality ← 最終目標，所有活動服務於此
blocks.en: Quality ← the ultimate goal, which all activities serve

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Design Space：Q8 最重要的術語——多維交互空間，在其中操作不視為監管變更；由申請方提出，需監管批准
blocks.en: Design Space: the most important Q8 term — a multidimensional interaction space within which operation is not considered a regulatory change; proposed by the applicant and subject to regulatory approval

blocks.zh: CPV：傳統三批次 PV 的替代方案，持續監控取代一次性驗證，代表製程驗證的現代範式
blocks.en: CPV: an alternative to the traditional three-batch PV; continuous monitoring replaces one-time validation, representing the modern paradigm of process validation

blocks.zh: PAT：即時量測技術系統，是 CPV 和 RTRT 的技術基礎；FDA PAT guidance (2004) 是其監管基礎
blocks.en: PAT: a system of real-time measurement technologies and the technical foundation of CPV and RTRT; the FDA PAT guidance (2004) is its regulatory basis

blocks.zh: Process Robustness：製程耐受性的度量，高穩健性 = 日常操作遠離失效邊界 = 製造風險降低
blocks.en: Process Robustness: a measure of process tolerance; high robustness = routine operation stays far from the failure boundary = reduced manufacturing risk

blocks.zh: Formal Experimental Design (DoE)：建立 Design Space 的核心工具，也用於識別 CPP 和 CQA 關係
blocks.en: Formal Experimental Design (DoE): the core tool for establishing the Design Space, also used to identify the relationship between CPPs and CQAs

blocks.zh: Lifecycle：Q8/Q9/Q10 三部曲共同的哲學基礎——知識貫穿從開發到退市的全週期
blocks.en: Lifecycle: the shared philosophical foundation of the Q8/Q9/Q10 trilogy — knowledge is applied across the whole period from development to discontinuation

blocks.zh: Quality：ICH 定義強調「對預期用途的適合性」，以鑑別、效價、純度為核心維度
blocks.en: Quality: the ICH definition stresses "suitability for intended use", with identity, strength, and purity as the core dimensions
